extDescription.message: Spots when you're about to ask ChatGPT something you already asked and takes you to that chat. Plus one-click chat cleanup.

dlgTitleHere.message: You already asked this in this chat

dlgSub.message: Jump back to the earlier answer instead of starting over, or ask again for a new one.

dlgSubHere.message: The answer is already above. Jump to it, or ask again if you want a new one.

titleMatches.message: The chat’s title matches your question

notSameTip.message: Don’t suggest this chat for this question again

welcome.message: Recall can learn from your existing chats so it spots questions you’ve already asked. It takes a few seconds, runs in the background, and everything stays on this device.

reloadMsg.message: Recall was updated or restarted. Reload this page to switch it back on. ChatGPT works normally in the meantime.

importProgress.message: Learning from your chats… {0} of {1} (you can keep chatting)

importDone.message: Done. Recall now knows {0} prompts from {1} chats ({2} new).

cleanFound.message: Recall found {0} chats you probably don’t need. Review, untick anything you want to keep, then delete in one go.

cleanEmpty.message: Nothing to clean up. Your chat list looks tidy ✨

confirmBody.message: They disappear from your history on every device. You can undo for a few seconds right after.

nudge.message: You have {0} chats that look stale (untitled, duplicates or untouched for months). Clear them out in a few clicks?

lastEmpty.message: Send a message on ChatGPT and Recall will show here whether it checked it, and why.

footer.message: 🔒 Your history never leaves this device.

healthWarn.message: Recall can’t find ChatGPT’s message box on this page. ChatGPT may have changed its layout; Recall will keep trying and won’t get in your way.

setNudge.message: Remind me to clean up stale chats

setLauncher.message: Show the cleanup button on ChatGPT

setDebug.message: Debug logging (shows prompt text in the browser console)

testerIdle.message: See exactly why Recall would or wouldn’t interrupt.

needChatgpt.message: Opening ChatGPT… run this again from there.

needReload.message: Reload the ChatGPT tab once so Recall can connect, then try again.

jumpMissed.message: Opened the chat, but couldn’t find that exact message on the page. Scroll to look for it.
